message.content: On September 20th, 2026, Thane Chambers asked Li Hua about her favorite first-person shooter game. Specifically, Thane inquired which game she was currently enjoying and what she liked most about it. Li Hua responded positively to this question, revealing that she was particularly fond of "Call of Duty: Warzone," appreciating its battle royale mode. She also expressed her enthusiasm for the strategic aspect of the game, as well as the exhilarating feeling of being in the final circle. Li Hua mentioned that she enjoys working with teammates and strategizing approaches to succeed. Thane Chambers, in return, commended Li Hua's choice and shared that he was currently playing "Apex Legends," noting the enjoyment he gets from the game's characters and abilities.
